now expects FY26 operating margins to be up 
"slightly" (vs. flat prior) given a strong 1H and benefit from higher mix of Windows 
OEM and Commercial on-prem revenue. Additionally, from an FX perspective, 4Q 
total revenue and COGS are expected to increase <1pt, with roughly a ~1pt revenue 
benefit in PBP and MPC, and <1pt in IC.
(=) F3Q Capex is expected to be sequentially lower following normal variability from 
cloud infrastructure buildouts and timing delivery of finance leases, with mix of 
short-lived assets expected to be similar to F2Q. Separately, mgmt. noted rising 
memory prices could impact capital expenditures for the full year; however impact 
to Microsoft Cloud gross margins will be phased given the 6-year depreciation life 
of these assets.
Estimate Revisions and Valuation
Incorporating F2Q results, guidance and our latest thoughts on the business, we 
increase FY26/27 revenue estimates to $328.2/$377.6bn from $327.0/$375.2bn 
and non-GAAP EPS estimates to $16.60/$19.10 from $16.43/$19.01, respectively.
